normalEncounters.name: Roof Rat
normalEncounters.lesson: Read a basic attack Tell and use Cover.
normalEncounters.description: A wiry rooftop rat that darts through tar paper seams and tests the flock's first defensive habits.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Lean city rat in a cropped utility hoodie, tiny harness pouch, taped paw wraps, and scuffed scavenger clips on a rain-slick rooftop beside HVAC ducts.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Low, narrow, fast scavenger with a long tail and hunched shoulders.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural limbs, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

normalEncounters.name: Signal Gull
normalEncounters.description: A loud opportunist gull that steals tempo, braces behind rooftop junk, and patches itself up if ignored.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Natural gull in a loose windbreaker wrap, reflective ankle bands, and a small scrap satchel, standing in a rooftop stance with food-carton and wet-antenna-wire styling cues.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Broad-winged scavenger with a cocked head and lifted beak.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

normalEncounters.name: Wire Hawk
normalEncounters.lesson: Respect Heavy Strike and Open Sky risk.
normalEncounters.description: A rooftop hawk that watches from the wires, then dives hard when the flock overextends.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Sharp-eyed hawk in a fitted courier shell, talon bands, and a narrow crossbody strap, framed by storm wires and open skyline above tar rooftops.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Tall raptor perch shape with angular wings and a hard forward lean.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

normalEncounters.name: Rooftop Raccoon
normalEncounters.lesson: Gear thief: adds Snags if ignored and slips behind rooftop cover.
normalEncounters.description: A nimble rooftop scavenger that rifles through route gear and slips behind HVAC cover before the flock can pin it down.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Natural raccoon in a cropped utility vest, reflective strap harness, small tool sling, and flexible paw wraps on rain-dark tar paper beside vents and wire bundles.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Low masked mammal with ringed tail, hunched shoulders, quick paws, and compact scavenger stance.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low and ready on all fours with head aligned to the body angle, tail free for balance, and clothing clear of shoulders and hips.

normalEncounters.name: Pigeon Enforcer
normalEncounters.lesson: Basic bruiser alternative that teaches steady Cover instead of swarm pressure.
normalEncounters.description: A heavy city pigeon that crowds the perch and forces the flock to spend Cover instead of setting up.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Stocky pigeon in a bomber-style chest wrap, wing-safe shoulder markings, concrete-gray talon bands, and subtle chain clips on a ledge.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Round broad chest, tucked head, short legs, and stubborn planted bird stance.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, planted on natural feet with folded wings unobstructed and jacket panels following the chest mass.

normalEncounters.name: Crow Saboteur
normalEncounters.lesson: Snag saboteur: slow it down before your discard turns hostile.
normalEncounters.description: A wire-smart crow that clips loose lines and leaves route systems tangled without needing any magic to cause trouble.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Glossy crow in a black courier harness, bright zipper pulls, wire-tool charms, and talon bands near breaker boxes and antenna cable.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Medium corvid with long beak, folded wing mass, dangling wire loops, and tilted problem-solver posture.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, bird grounded on talons with tool props clipped to harness, never held by invented hands.

normalEncounters.name: Rat Courier
normalEncounters.lesson: Alarm runner: interrupt its setup before the next hit gets sharper.
normalEncounters.description: A fast courier rat that carries warning tags through gutters and makes the next enemy wave arrive better prepared.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Lean rat in a lightweight crossbody satchel, reflective trim, paw wraps, and rain-specked fur near gutter runs and route tags.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Small stretched runner with long tail, low head, and satchel diagonal.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, paused mid-ready on four natural paws with satchel stable against the ribs.

normalEncounters.name: Weasel Cutpurse
normalEncounters.lesson: Tempo thief: chips, Winded pressure, and Cover-based Wingbeat disruption.
normalEncounters.description: A narrow cutpurse that clips loose straps, tangles route gear, and vanishes into the next drain gap.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Weasel in a slim dark vest, tiny clip pouch, and close paw wraps near alley straps and drain covers.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Long skinny mammal with pointed muzzle, tiny paws, and fast low profile.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low on natural paws with clothing flush to the body.

normalEncounters.name: Skunk Chemist
normalEncounters.lesson: Area-denial debuffer: Frail and Snag pressure arrive before late districts.
normalEncounters.description: A prepared skunk that turns narrow alleys into no-go zones with nasty natural deterrence and found containers.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Striped skunk in a bright hazard-style harness, clipped non-sci-fi canister props, paw wraps, and tail fully free near alley drainage.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Low black-and-white mammal with raised plume tail, rounded back, and warning stance.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, four paws grounded with tail free and harness clear of the hips.

normalEncounters.name: Alley Cat
normalEncounters.lesson: Burst hunter: interrupt the stalk before its pounce spikes.
normalEncounters.description: A patient alley hunter that waits under market shadow, then bursts through a gap in the formation.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Lean city cat in a narrow streetwear collar, asymmetrical back panel, soft ankle wraps, and small side pouch among alley crates and fire escapes.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Sleek crouched feline with arched back, sharp ears, long tail, and spring-loaded legs.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched on all fours with tail free, natural shoulders, and no sleeves or human jacket shape.

normalEncounters.name: Jackrabbit Sprinter
normalEncounters.lesson: Speed pressure: small hits and Winded turns punish slow setup.
normalEncounters.description: A long-legged rooftop sprinter that darts along painted service lanes and rain-slick curb arrows before the flock can settle.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Jackrabbit in a lightweight runner harness, flexible leg bands, tiny side pouch, reflective route-tag clips, and no footwear or leg-restricting clothing on cracked concrete beside rooftop track paint and curb drains.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Tall-eared rabbit with long back legs, lean body, and explosive crouch.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched on natural paws with hind legs free and ears readable.

normalEncounters.name: Hedgehog Curb-Crosser
normalEncounters.lesson: Low blocker: small body, steady Cover, and Winded lane tax.
normalEncounters.description: A compact curb defender that is hard to dislodge and slows the flock in tight concrete lanes.
normalEncounters.visualBrief: Hedgehog in a tiny roadworker harness, reflective trim, and paw wraps that leave spines and legs free near curb drains.
normalEncounters.silhouette: Very low oval body with spines, small face, and stubborn little feet.
normalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low and grounded with natural spines visible and no bulky clothing.

rivalEncounters.name: Tarline Jackdaw
rivalEncounters.lesson: Optional elite pressure with better rewards.
rivalEncounters.description: A rival jackdaw line-worker that uses tar cords, braces, and sharp rooftop feints to tax careless routes.
rivalEncounters.visualBrief: Compact black-and-gray city jackdaw in tar-sheen utility streetwear: cropped work shell, asymmetric cord harness, brass talon bands, scuffed pouch, and abstract black-gold repair patches around a rooftop tar line.
rivalEncounters.silhouette: Small upright corvid with a quick beak, folded wings, long cord loops, and a compact line-worker stance.
rivalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet or talons; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

rivalEncounters.name: Gutter Baron
rivalEncounters.lesson: Elite: armored bruiser that alternates a guard turn with a heavy swing.
rivalEncounters.description: A bulky sewer-rat boss of the gutter routes, all patched plating, low patience, and crushing counterweight.
rivalEncounters.visualBrief: Heavy rat in layered street-work armor made from non-sci-fi scrap plates, canvas straps, and taped paws, braced beside a rooftop drain and bent service panels.
rivalEncounters.silhouette: Squat armored bruiser with a thick neck, wide back, and heavy tail base.
rivalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural limbs, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

rivalEncounters.name: Armadillo Roller
rivalEncounters.lesson: Early elite charger: breaks greedy lines with setup Cover into a heavy roll.
rivalEncounters.description: A tough curb runner that curls through alleys and knocks loose cover out of place.
rivalEncounters.visualBrief: Armadillo with flexible strap accents, shell decals, tiny side pouch, and scuffed paw wraps near curb stones and traffic cones.
rivalEncounters.silhouette: Low armored mammal with domed shell, pointed snout, short legs, and rolling-read posture.
rivalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, uncurled but tense, with natural shell visible and straps not changing body shape.

rivalEncounters.name: Mongoose Counterfighter
rivalEncounters.lesson: Reactive duelist: setup Cover turns into a counterstrike if ignored.
rivalEncounters.description: A quick counterfighter that watches for rhythm and snaps into openings before the flock resets.
rivalEncounters.visualBrief: Mongoose in a sleek fitted vest, flexible flank straps, paw wraps, and market-tile grit with no sleeve shapes.
rivalEncounters.silhouette: Slim low carnivore with pointed muzzle, arched back, long tail, and springy stance.
rivalEncounters.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low on four paws with clothing tight to torso and shoulders free.

bosses.name: The Tar-Crowned Crow
bosses.description: A commanding crow whose crown-like streetwear and oil-slick rain gear make the broken flyway feel like a toll road it owns.
bosses.visualBrief: Large natural crow in a dark luxe rain shell, glossy oil-slick shoulder wrap, crown-like hood trim, tiny chain clips, and black talon bands atop a rooftop chokepoint of cables, tar paper, and rain-dark puddles; no literal tar on feathers or body.
bosses.silhouette: Large crowned corvid shaped by hood trim and cloak-like wing mass, with a high perch stance.
bosses.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.
